items.title: Skunk Ape / Bigfoot
items.location: Road south of Lake Cottonmouth, Grassrivers (east of the lake toward Gambit Bay, south of Hamlet)
items.description: A tall, hairy creature crouches over a deer carcass on the road. Approach and it flees into the bushes; follow it to a wooden effigy in a tree (green mist) and your character faints as hairy feet approach in a cutscene, waking up at the lake's edge. Findable from Chapter 1. The San Andreas urban legend is a real creature this time — the Florida cryptid known as the Skunk Ape.

items.title: Kirk & Mr. Mangrove (Skunk Ape questline)
items.location: Skeeter's Bar, Hamlet — read the flyer, then call Kirk (461-555-0139)
items.description: Read the 'Have You Seen Skunk Ape???' flyer at Skeeter's Bar and call Kirk to start three night missions: Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies (three effigies in Pelican Valley) and Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (Advanced Skunk Apeonomics, helicopter and tranquiliser darts). The twist: Mr. Mangrove is Harry Sherrick, missing for ten years and deformed by swamp spores. At the end you choose whether to shoot him (Kirk pays $10,000 plus the unique Mister Mangrove Laird 350 tranquiliser rifle) or not (Kirk dies). Counts toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.

items.title: UFO abduction (The Truth Is Out There)
items.location: Road north-west of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County (east of Port Gellhorn), after 02:00, alone
items.description: After Chapter 1, go alone to this road after 02:00 in-game. Find a parked car with flashing lights (if there is none, leave and return — the spawn is random), follow the clothing trail into the woods toward a blue light, and a UFO is lifting a woman. Help her (agree to fetch her car), return to the car on the road, and the UFO returns and abducts your character. Works as Jason or Lucia, and pops the trophy The Truth Is Out There. A nod to the Mount Chiliad UFO of GTA V and to the X-Files.

items.title: Alien prisoner in an underground lab
items.location: South Point Airfield, Hamlet — radio tower, hatch on the roof, lift to the basement
items.description: After the abduction (E3), your character dreams — note the number above the keypad in the dream (usually 2134). Go to the South Point Airfield radio tower, climb to the roof, enter the hatch, go down, enter the code, and ride the lift to the basement. Press the panel buttons until all lights are green, take the milk bottle from the table, put it in the capsule, and a small grey alien appears — carry it out before the poison gas, and outside a UFO comes to collect it and destroys a government vehicle. An alternative location is named as an 'Abandoned Site' north-east of Lake Cottonmouth. The keypad code itself is disputed (see the disputed items).

items.title: Literal Easter egg on the radio tower
items.location: Tallest radio/TV tower, South Vice-Dale County / Vice City — about a 6–7 minute climb
items.description: Climb the tallest radio tower (roughly six to seven minutes) to find a bird's nest at the top holding a painted Easter egg — a literal easter egg. Take it and throw it from the top, and a cutscene shows it landing on the windscreen of a car below, driven by a real-estate agent (or shady lawyer, per GameSpot). The only egg whose name is literal. Found by X user @xGarbett.

items.title: Giant mutant crab / Crab Lab
items.location: Abandoned research station south-west of Pelican Valley, Grassrivers (by boat, north of Key Lento)
items.description: Turn on the power (circuit breaker outside) and go in: a locked computer (password 'CLEAVES', carved into a floorboard), a note reading 'SAFE CODE = DOUBLE SUCCESS' and a clipboard in the back shack reading 'SUCCESS = 0036' — the safe code is 0072 (about $1,070–$1,098). While at the computer, a giant mutant crab drops from above and attacks. The boathouse (code 0212) holds the Crabshack VF5 SMG, a $10,000 bag and a jet ski to escape on. A nod to the E3 2006 'giant enemy crabs' meme.

items.title: Cool Dog / Lucky Dog (jet-ski rescue dog)
items.location: Far out at sea, e.g. Gambit Bay or off Vice City — get stranded swimming
items.description: Swim or get stranded far out at sea and a dog wearing goggles arrives on a jet ski to rescue you, carrying you to an island full of other dogs — with cash and free sunglasses as a reward. Supposedly it also leads to a hidden money stash. Do not leave before the reward is given. In-game name: 'Cool Dog'.

items.title: Dexter Morgan's apartment
items.location: Washington Island, east Vice City — Trinity Apartments, 2nd floor, near the Pay 'N' Spray
items.description: A replica of Dexter's home from the TV series Dexter. On the roof there is a 'kill kit' (syringes, knife, duct tape, rope) in a toolbox, and a boat like his 'Slice of Life' is moored nearby. You cannot enter the apartment itself. First spotted in the 'An Extended Look' trailer (around 18:49, Lucia parachuting).

items.title: Brian O'Conner's Mitsubishi Eclipse
items.location: Inside a villa garage on Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands
items.description: A lime-green car with side graphics, a tall rear wing and a 'Terada Tires' decal — Brian O'Conner's Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious (2001), a tribute to Paul Walker. It can be stolen and registered at a Pay 'n' Spray as a permanent vehicle. In-game model: Maibatsu Penumbra FF; the plate reads 'HAD YOU'.

items.title: Michael De Santa's boat
items.location: Outside Jason's house in the Leonida Keys
items.description: Board the boat outside Jason's house and check the GPS screen behind the wheel: it still shows the map of Los Santos (GTA V), not Leonida — the same boat stolen from Michael in GTA V.

items.title: Arthur Morgan's cowboy hat
items.location: Yard sale south of Port Gellhorn, Kelly County (north-west of the Dirt Merchants mod shop, above the race track)
items.description: A brown 'Genuine Cowboy Hat' for $35, sitting on a guitar case on a sofa at a yard sale — Arthur Morgan's hat from Red Dead Redemption 2. Usable by Jason and Lucia, from Chapter 2. Stock can change, so check again if it is not there.

items.title: Tony the talking parrot
items.location: Behind Three Sheets Liquor, Key Lento — after the mission about Shirley's house
items.description: After the Shirley's house mission (Salt Squid Rum), return to the shop: a red parrot in a cage in the back yard gives hints about a stash ('Generator… Generator') — a vent near the generator holds about $1,200–$1,384, plus a safe inside the shop (about $971). The exact amounts vary between sources. A nod to Tony, Ken Rosenberg's parrot in GTA: San Andreas.

items.title: Niko Bellic cameo ('The Hitman')
items.location: Chapter 5, 'Top of the World, Ma' — story mission Taking Liberties, Giorgio's penthouse
items.description: Late in the story, Niko Bellic — older, grey-haired, voiced by Michael Hollick — appears in Giorgio's penthouse in two cutscenes: threatening Giorgio, then returning to collect a shipment after the Coast Guard heist. Giorgio shouts 'Daddy's back, bitches!' (GTA IV's opening line) and the 'Soviet Connection' theme plays. Rockstar's credits list him as 'The Hitman'. Not a hidden egg — part of the late story — but the biggest cameo in the game.

items.title: Mount Chiliad bar conversation
items.location: Bar next to the meeting spot, early in the story (when Donnie calls you to meet him and Brian)
items.description: Two NPCs at a table discuss the madness at Mount Chiliad, San Andreas — including a hidden bunker under the mountain holding a jetpack. A dialogue nod to the Mount Chiliad mystery of GTA V / GTA Online. No Chiliad puzzle has been solved in GTA VI yet.

items.title: Belville conspiracy house ('IT'S A SIMULATION')
items.location: Belville, Leonard County — break into the garage
items.description: A house whose photo mysteriously appeared in GTA: San Andreas Definitive Edition (2021) turns out to be a real location in GTA VI. Break into its garage to find a conspiracy board: the resident knows he lives in a video game — he cannot buy a ticket to Los Santos, cannot leave Leonida, sees many doppelgangers (repeated NPC models), finds buildings he cannot enter, and notes the crime surge. A wall mind-map reads 'IT'S A SIMULATION' in red. Found by Jared from the GTA mapping community. The strongest meta egg in the game.

items.title: Fabien LaRouche in a magazine
items.location: Body Copy magazine (bodybuilding) — one copy is in the gym Jason uses
items.description: The Body Copy magazine carries an article called 'Twilight Tantra' about Fabien LaRouche, the yoga instructor from GTA V, now teaching at the Dwindle Wood Retirement Community in Waning Sands.

items.title: 'ASS MAN' plate (Seinfeld)
items.location: On the back plate of an Imponte Phoenix — the red Phoenix appears in the Chapter 1 mission Unwanted Attention
items.description: A Leonida plate reading ASS MAN on the back of an Imponte Phoenix. A reference to Seinfeld, episode 'The Fusilli Jerry', where Cosmo Kramer holds the ASSMAN plate.

items.title: Love Fist & V-Rock
items.location: Love Fist sticker in the world; Jason wears a V-Rock logo T-shirt
items.description: A Love Fist sticker (the fictional Vice City rock band) appears in the world, and Jason wears a T-shirt with the V-Rock logo (the Vice City rock radio station). Both are callbacks to GTA: Vice City.

items.title: 'Petty Forever' sticker (Tom Petty)
items.location: On the door of Uncle Jack's liquor store
items.description: A sticker reading 'Petty Forever' on the door of Uncle Jack's liquor store — a nod to Tom Petty, whose songs feature on the classic-rock station V-Rock.

items.title: Tom Everett memoir / Liberty City 2008 book
items.location: A readable book in Jason's house
items.description: A book in Jason's house: the memoir of Tom Everett, bodyguard of Gracie Ancelotti in Liberty City and Alderney, who survived because he was sick on the day a gunman killed five of Gracie's guards. Another book mentions events from 2008, the year of GTA IV — a reference to Niko Bellic's kidnapping of Gracie.

items.title: Wade Hebert on the 'Final Act' podcast
items.location: True-crime podcast 'Final Act' (host Reagan Carter), available from free-roam
items.description: One episode of the Final Act podcast covers the deaths of Floyd and Debra (GTA V): Wade says he was 'at the titty bar' that day, and Reagan shows a photo of three men in a restaurant — Wade names Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton, and calls the third man his 'best friend' without naming him (Trevor).

items.title: 'Rad Dads Redemption Tour' poster
items.location: Notice board outside Three Sheets Liquor, Key Lento
items.description: A flyer with a skull on the notice board: the 'Rad Dads Redemption Tour' — a play on the name Red Dead Redemption.

items.title: 'New Austin' plate
items.location: Random cars in Leonida traffic
items.description: A random car plate reading 'New Austin', with a cactus and desert-sunset design — a reference to the Red Dead Redemption state of New Austin.

items.title: Grand Senora Desert & Grapeseed postcards
items.location: Inside a trailer at a burnt-out fishing property
items.description: A wall of photos inside the trailer holds postcards reading 'Grand Senora Desert: A Great Place To Get Lost' and 'Greetings From Grapeseed' — both places from GTA V's San Andreas.

items.title: 'Wind Chimes' ringtone
items.location: Phone settings — ringtones
items.description: The 'Wind Chimes' ringtone is available in the phone settings — the same ringtone Michael De Santa used in GTA V.

items.title: Freddie's bunker (Freddie Gibbs)
items.location: West of North Leonard County — find it via a Snapmatic post about a fortified compound
items.description: A fortified compound west of North Leonard County. Enter via the watchtower and over the barn roof; watch for mines and drones. Freddie is inside recording a podcast and preparing for the apocalypse, and there is a storm warning on the news. Choose 'stay with Freddie' and the reward is a Dubster plus $5,000. A pre-release rumour (HipHopGamer / PC Gamer) now confirmed in-game by two guides.

items.title: 'RX-Men' comic
items.location: A comic found in the world
items.description: A comic called 'RX-Men' — a parody of X-Men with drug-themed superheroes and a villain named Dr. Placebo.

items.title: Kyle the 'Red Hulk'
items.location: Strangers & Freaks side quest — meet Kyle McKittrick at the giant strawberry farm (Lucia knew him first)
items.description: Help Kyle with his farm and collect chemicals for him — then Kyle eats a strange strawberry and mutates into a giant red monster, rampaging: throwing NPCs at a helicopter (which falls), flipping cars, immune to bullets. Jason calms him down ('Buddy'), with a choice to hug him or not. Found live by IShowSpeed after about 23 hours of play. A Marvel Red Hulk nod (the helicopter scene echoes Captain America: Brave New World). Whether hugging him makes him appear again later is not confirmed.

items.title: Capri demon / satanic ritual
items.location: Abandoned building in Capri, south of Tortoise Lake (north of Capri, near the railway)
items.description: Inside the abandoned building: a bloody pentagram on the floor, candles and a ritual journal. Knock out an NPC nearby (construction site to the left), drag the body onto the pentagram — the room goes dark, candles light, and your partner calls from upstairs (a hallucination: your partner possessed, another character as a demon). Return to the pentagram and the NPC rises as a demon — only fire kills it (Molotov or petrol in the room; bullets and explosions do not work). Note: TechTudo claims this ritual opens the trophy The Truth Is Out There, which contradicts PowerPyx (UFO) — see the disputed items.

items.title: Ocean View Hotel
items.location: Ocean Beach, Vice Beach, Vice-Dale County
items.description: The hotel where Tommy Vercetti had his first safehouse in Vice City (2002). It appears in Trailer 1 (0:33) and Trailer 2 (bar and outdoor pool). Its rooftop bar is also the location of the trophy In The Beginning… (Apple Martini, $10).

items.title: Tenebrae Lux — secret ending
items.location: Black-and-white puzzle game on the JoySystem console in Jason's house
items.description: Beyond the locked door in Tenebrae Lux: a phone in the bunker asks for a 6-digit code, found from anomalies in rooms marked with October dates (a wrong clock, a photo with an extra person, a phone ringing a different number of times) — the code differs per save. Finish it and the door at the end of the pier opens, and you wake in a dark cabin with a developer desk and two monitors. A meta game-inside-a-game.

items.title: 'Weird Al' Yankovic — radio host
items.location: The '80s hits radio station
items.description: 'Weird Al' Yankovic hosts his own '80s hits station on GTA VI's radio. His name appears on Rockstar's official cast list (6,000 names, published 19 Nov), alongside Bad Bunny.

items.title: Sam Houser cameo?
items.location: Unknown
items.description: Sam Houser, Rockstar's co-founder, is allegedly in the game. One source only, and it is explicitly marked 'allegedly' — Rockstar has not confirmed it. Do not upgrade this without a second piece of evidence.

items.title: Fat merman
items.location: A small island in Gambit Bay
items.description: A fat merman sunbathing on a small island in Gambit Bay. One source only, and no exact location is given.

items.title: Meteorite
items.location: Mountain peak in Lummox County (WikiGames) / south-east slope of Mount Kalaga National Park, near a camp (Sportskeeda)
items.description: A meteorite on a mountain peak, still glowing; you can take a shard of it. The two sources do not agree on the location (Lummox vs Mount Kalaga), so they cannot be merged into one certain claim. The Mount Kalaga version is near a camp with a phone lying on the ground that holds a UFO-abduction recording.

items.title: Beached whale that can explode
items.location: Beach area in Leonida
items.description: A beached whale (cetacean stranding) that can explode. One source only — a nod to the famous exploding whale of GTA V.

items.title: White tiger in a cage
items.location: Unknown — a locked animal cage
items.description: A rare white tiger in a locked animal cage. One source only, no location given.

items.title: Animal jumpscare in the trunk
items.location: Car trunks — loot one carelessly
items.description: Loot a car trunk carelessly and a pet sleeping inside can attack and kill you. One source only. Similar to the separate python-in-the-trunk report (see the oddities).

items.title: Cat attacks when you steal its car
items.location: Steal a car that has a cat inside
items.description: Steal a car with a cat inside and a cutscene plays of the cat attacking your character; it can be thrown out of the car. Two sources, but both are thin (a list and a countdown video), so it stays reported.

sources.name: YouTube — 16 Easter Eggs You Might Have Missed

items.title: Saw-style kidnapper
items.location: Unknown — no location or method given
items.description: Mentioned only in a GamingBible headline about the pentagon demon and a Saw-style kidnapper, with no location or method in the readable excerpt. No details are invented here.

items.title: 'Gator Face' / Florida Joker mission
items.location: On trial on TV, then met in free-roam outside a bar in Leonard County
items.description: A face-tattooed criminal ('Gator Face') is on trial on TV, then met in free-roam outside a bar in Leonard County, with a stranger mission to find his stolen pet python. One source, and a questionable AI-content site. The trailer-1 Florida Joker is confirmed (Beebom), but this 'Gator Face' mission is not.

items.title: UFO article in the news app
items.location: The phone's news app
items.description: The phone's news app shows a UFO article. One source only.

items.title: Mount Chiliad eye truck artwork
items.location: On the outside of a truck
items.description: Conspiracy eye artwork (Mount Chiliad) on the outside of a truck. One source only.

items.title: Influencer vlogging at the top of the tower
items.location: Top of the radio tower (E5) — sometimes
items.description: While climbing the radio tower (E5), an influencer is sometimes vlogging at the top. If she is there, the parachute cannot be used to get down (even if she is removed) — you have to climb back down. One source; related to E5.

items.title: Police react when filmed
items.location: Wherever police are making an arrest
items.description: Police who are arresting someone react when the player films them. One source only.

items.title: Influencer eaten by a python (Facebook Reel)
items.location: Facebook Reel, Michi Gaming, 20 Nov 2026 (reel 1988665145441723, 7,036 likes)
items.description: The claim: 'Easter egg: influencer eaten by a python!!' — a clip of a woman influencer taking a selfie in a swamp, then a giant python grabs her leg and swallows her, while her selfie stick chokes the snake to death. Why disputed: the reel's own summary says the visuals match Red Dead Redemption 2 style; commenters are split, with some recognising GTA 6 gameplay and others comparing the visuals and NPC behaviour to RDR2 (the same Rockstar assets) and questioning the realism. WikiGames lists it as an easter egg without verification — one fan-wiki is not confirmation. No major outlet (GameSpot, IGN, Kotaku, PowerPyx) has reported this egg. Shown ONLY as disputed, never as a confirmed GTA 6 egg.

items.title: Two dogs mating in a driveway (Facebook Reel)
items.location: Facebook Reel, IMGX, 19 Nov 2026 (reel 1076172468775137, 6,722 likes)
items.description: The reel shows two dogs mating in a house driveway, captioned 'Not even 5 mins into the game' / 'haven't even played for 10min btw'. Framing: this is at most viral ambient-animal behaviour turned into a meme, NOT a clear easter egg. Commenters explicitly questioned its authenticity — 'I'm several hours in and this doesn't happen' — some suspect AI involvement, and others compare it to RDR2. The tone of the comments is sarcastic entertainment, not confirmation. Shown as a reported meme, not as an official easter egg.

items.title: Bigfoot: 'hunt him, kill him, then you turn into a frog'
items.location: BuzzFeed, quoting X users
items.description: BuzzFeed writes: 'According to X users, there's a secret mission where you can hunt him down and kill him... and then you turn into a frog?' — with BuzzFeed's own question mark. The verified Kirk questline (E2) ends with a shoot-or-don't choice and NO frog transformation in any PowerPyx or OutputLag guide. Probably a misread, an X joke, or a mix-up with another mechanic (spore/hallucination effects). Do not present it as the outcome of Kirk's questline.

items.title: Alien lab keypad code: 2134 vs 2314 vs 2341
items.location: Alien lab keypad (see E4)
items.description: The alien egg itself is confirmed; the NUMBER is not. PowerPyx and YouTube walkthroughs say 2134 (read from the dream). OutputLag says try 2314, then 2341 — 'neither code works in every save' (the code differs per save / per dream). In the guide: the code is shown in your own dream (usually 2134; some players report 2314/2341) — never promise one fixed number.

items.title: Trigger for 'The Truth Is Out There': UFO vs Capri ritual
items.location: Trophy trigger — two competing claims
items.description: PowerPyx (+ GameSpot, 20 Nov): the trigger is the UFO abduction (E3). TechTudo (via Cut.pro): completing the Capri ritual (E29) opens the same trophy. Both cannot be true for one trophy. Until a third source tests both, the UFO route is the main one (2+ strong sources) and the ritual is an unverified alternative claim — neither is written here as certain.

items.title: 'Not every car can be stolen'
items.location: Viral clip of a player sitting in a car that will not move
items.description: A viral clip shows a player sitting in a car that will not move. HappyGamer itself writes 'Treat these as unconfirmed' — it could be a car needing the Key Cloner, a tracked car, or a momentary bug. No guide has replicated it. Listed here and under Bugs, because the claim straddles both.

items.title: NPCs walk into walls
items.location: Various buildings and interiors
items.description: Pedestrians and NPCs walk into walls and get stuck. Minor, not game-breaking.

items.title: Clipping through walls / sofas
items.location: Police station (MichaelDoesLife); general
items.description: Jason and a police officer clip into each other, get sucked into a wall or sofa, and roll around for several seconds until the officer is knocked out and Jason is free.

items.title: Falling through the map (prologue)
items.location: Prologue — Lucia is tased by police while stealing a scooter (scripted, she is always caught)
items.description: After being tased, the scooter's weight makes Lucia clip through the ground and fall below Leonida until the game returns her to the police. If it does not return her: restart and replay the mission. The most frequently reported bug.

items.title: Crash / freeze / lost progress
items.location: Prologue and general, PS5 + Xbox
items.description: Repeated crashes in the prologue, freezes, missing textures, audio problems, and hours of progress lost even though autosave exists — autosave does not always trigger in the prologue or at certain checkpoints, and the save menu does not show the autosave (use the load menu). Mitigation: save manually often and rotate save slots.

items.title: Missing airplane door animation
items.location: Mission 'Gone Fishing' — Donnie's rescue plane
items.description: There is no door-opening animation: Jason clips straight through the plane's body into the pilot's seat.

items.title: Frame-rate drop (target 30 FPS)
items.location: Dense areas and while driving; all consoles, including PS5 Pro
items.description: Target is 30 FPS, dropping in dense areas; there is no 60 FPS / performance mode. Not a pure bug — a performance limitation — but listed because it is the most common player complaint.

items.title: Softlock in an early Lucia mission
items.location: Early Lucia mission — after leaving the bank
items.description: After leaving the bank early in Lucia's story, the mission cannot be completed and progress stalls. Reported workaround: reload an earlier checkpoint or save. No statement from Rockstar.

items.title: Floating coffee cup
items.location: Safehouse, when switching between Jason and Lucia
items.description: A coffee cup floats in the air when switching characters. One source (a review).

items.title: Cosmetic pop-in (clothing)
items.location: General gameplay
items.description: Brief clothing pop-in on Jason and Lucia. Seen in the pre-release patch; unclear whether it is still in the launch patch.

items.title: Boat appears stuck to a bridge
items.location: While driving with Jason and Cal
items.description: A boat suddenly appears tilted against a bridge, almost onto the road, then returns to position.

items.title: NPCs do not react to a boat collision
items.location: Mission 'Gone Fishing' — Jason rams a boat full of people with a speedboat
items.description: The NPCs do not react and the boat does not collide or capsize.

items.title: Plane flies through a building (anti-crash)
items.location: Jump out of a plane before it crashes
items.description: The plane does not explode — it flies through the building ahead while Jason parachutes to safety.

items.title: Falling from a plane without damage
items.location: Jason jumps from a moving plane without a parachute while chased by police
items.description: He survives with no damage (not a cheat). The plane itself still explodes.

items.title: Slingshot glitch, GTA IV style
items.location: Hit a tree or bush with a car
items.description: The car is flung far across the map (like the GTA IV swing glitch, but lighter); the car is wrecked.

items.title: 'Phone to Shadow Realm'
items.location: Wedge Jason between a car and a fence, then open the phone
items.description: Jason clips through the map and falls into a black void. Requires a game restart. Save manually before trying it.

items.title: 'PS1' graphics / missing textures
items.location: Intro, before the prologue
items.description: Vehicle and NPC pop-in, world textures missing — like the Cyberpunk 2077 1.0 launch. One report; possibly a failed asset stream.

items.title: NPCs swim sideways
items.location: Leonida's waters
items.description: NPCs swimming sideways in the water.

items.title: VRR on Xbox unlocks frame rate
items.location: Xbox Series X|S with a VRR TV
items.description: Turning on VRR reportedly unlocks the frame rate above 30 FPS. May change with a patch; Rockstar has not commented.

items.title: PS5 error CE-108255-1
items.location: On starting the game (PS5)
items.description: A generic game error; reportedly gone after installing the 602 MB update.

items.title: Cheats locked until the story ends
items.location: Progress menu
items.description: Cheats reportedly only appear in the Progress menu after all story missions are finished; while a cheat is active you cannot save and trophies do not pop during that session. Rockstar has not published an official cheat list, and the count (about 61) is unverified.

items.title: 'Not every car can be stolen' (bug version)
items.location: Viral clip of a car that will not move
items.description: Same claim as D6, listed under Bugs too: a viral clip of a player sitting in a car that will not move. HappyGamer writes 'Treat these as unconfirmed' — it could be a car needing the Key Cloner, a tracked car, or a momentary bug. No guide has replicated it.

items.title: Rumor: 'Rockstar apologised + fix on 25 Nov'
items.location: A viral X post
items.description: A widely shared X post claims Rockstar apologised and will fix things on 25 Nov. There is NO support for it on any official Rockstar channel (Newswire or support) as of 21 Nov. Treat it as a rumour.

items.title: Accusation that JasonTheWeen's crash was 'staged'
items.location: Notebookcheck, on one streamer's crash clip
items.description: Notebookcheck writes that 'JasonTheWeen critics believe the ordeal was staged to attract attention.' Crashes and lost progress in general remain CONFIRMED (B4, many sources); only the accusation about one specific clip is disputed. Do not use it to discredit other crash reports.

items.title: Apollo Aggregates money glitch (reference)
items.location: Red warehouse east of Hamlet
items.description: The save/reload loot-respawn money glitch at the Apollo Aggregates warehouse. Full panel in the Glitch & Farming tab. DISPUTED: 2 sources for (KeeNgamer, allblogthings) vs 2 against (afleurdenet, vanotherlevel). Shown as reported, never as confirmed.

items.title: Mandy — Key Lento (mystery)
items.location: Brian Heder's rental house, Key Lento, Leonida Keys — early Chapter 1 mission 'Pipework'
items.description: Brian sends Jason to collect rent. Observed clues, reported by players: (a) while Jason fixes a clogged sink pipe, a rotting human finger comes out — Mandy panics, snatches it ('Oops! Forgot about that.') and hurries Jason out; (b) her car trunk holds a meat cleaver, scissors, bleach chemicals and duct tape (FandomWire adds acid and several saws); (c) her yard has a patch of disturbed ground that looks like a freshly dug grave (Gamebrott: covered with dry cement); (d) Mandy flirts with Jason relentlessly (bikini, claims they were 'almost married' — a version Jason does not acknowledge), admits breaking the tap on purpose so Jason would come, and stalks him via Snapmatic. COMMUNITY THEORY — NOT FACT: 'Mandy is a psychopath / serial killer.' There is no confirmation from any cutscene or from Rockstar — Gamebrott itself writes that there is no further direct explanation from cutscenes or Rockstar. Always present it as theory.

items.title: Polar bear escapes from a truck
items.location: Random event on the highway
items.description: Animal activists stop a truck carrying a polar bear in a cage, open the back door shouting 'Let her out!' — and the bear comes out and attacks them (several killed or mauled). Another variant: an orca freed by activists throws an activist into the air. Kotaku: the bear escapes while being transported to a zoo; if the event happens after you know the hunter, the hunter will buy the dead bear.

items.title: 'Furry illegal' in Leonida
items.location: All of Leonida
items.description: Being a furry (anthropomorphic animal costume) is illegal in Leonida: police can shoot on sight ('No Paws Laws'); there is an in-game news article 'Governor Declares Leonida Furry-Free'; even saying the memes 'Uwu / Rawr xD / hewwo' can get you arrested. There is a 'furry rebels' hideout on Starfish Island (IGN via GTA6-Life). A parody of Florida and internet culture.

items.title: Mandy's locked room
items.location: Mandy's house, Key Lento
items.description: One room in her house is locked tight — Jason cannot enter it at all. Suspected to be connected to the Mandy mystery (W1), but its contents are unknown. One source. Do not invent what is inside.

items.title: UFO abduction recording on a phone
items.location: A camp on the south-east trail toward the top of Mount Kalaga National Park
items.description: A phone lies on the ground near a bicycle. It can be picked up and played: a recording of an NPC being abducted by a UFO while screaming for someone by name (probably a sibling, who had warned them not to go there). Related to the meteorite report (R-E3) on the same slope.

items.title: Orca throws an activist
items.location: Offshore / animal truck
items.description: Activists free an orca, and the orca throws an activist into the air. A viral X clip; one source chain.

items.title: Python in the car trunk
items.location: Random car trunk
items.description: A python jumps out of a car trunk when the player tries to steal the car: 'F***ing snake tried to eat me when opening a trunk in GTA 6.' Related to the trunk-jumpscare report (R-E6).

items.title: Extreme NPC road rage
items.location: Leonida's roads
items.description: Bump an NPC's car and the NPC chases you for a long time, then rams you to stop you, gets out and attacks you. A far bigger reaction than in GTA V.

items.title: 'Spooning Cal'
items.location: Jason's house, early in the game
items.description: Cal comes over to install the JoyStation, they drink all night, and in the morning they wake up sleeping cuddled together (spooning) in the bedroom. A scripted story moment, not a systemic behaviour.

items.title: Bert 'trousers down'
items.location: Next to Mandy's house
items.description: Bert — a character described as representing the nonsensical right wing — appears next to Mandy's house with his trousers down, 'flashing the renters'. The source gives no further detail.

items.title: Dundee polar bear (1878) reference?
items.location: The polar-bear event (W2)
items.description: Dundee Culture links the polar-bear event (W2) to the story of Bruin, a polar bear that escaped and roamed Dundee in 1878. An inference by a local site — possibly coincidence. Kept as a reported reference theory.
